articles.title: Apple outranks Walmart and Amazon on efforts to curb toxic chemicals in products and packaging
articles.description: Most companies are backsliding when it comes to consumer safety, but Apple bucked the trend in a new review that found nearly half of the retailers reassessed lost ground on toxic chemicals and plastics. IKEA, Target, and Sephora followed Apple with A- grades. The report evaluates how retailers disclose and address hazardous chemicals and plastics in their products, packaging, and supply chains.
